out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the QUATERNARY AMMONIUM solution was measured at 500+ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food- contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of QUATERNARY AMMONIUM solution at 150-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. PIC diluted solution in sink with water to maintain a concentration of 200-400ppm. PIC called Ecolab during the inspection to recalibrate the dispenser.
